title: My first day in Blox City

music.source: ElevenLabs eleven_music_v2_5, one take per track (900 credits each)

prompts.cruise: Instrumental only, no vocals. 60 seconds. Sunny laid-back 80s synthwave cruising track for a cartoon seaside city at sunset: warm analog bass, bright synth stabs, gated drums, catchy but simple, 104 bpm, loopable, light and fun.
prompts.chase: Instrumental only, no vocals. 45 seconds. Fast funky cartoon police-chase music: driving slap bass, tight breakbeat drums, punchy brass stabs, wah guitar, playful and comedic rather than dark, 150 bpm, high energy from the first second, loopable.

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [dry] First day in Blox City. Nine dollars. One scooter. By sunset, every cop in town was chasing me.
lines.caption: First day in Blox City Nine dollars One scooter By sunset every cop in town was chasing me

lines.speaker: lu
lines.tts: [gruff] New kid. I got a job for you.
lines.caption: New kid I got a job for you

lines.speaker: lu
lines.tts: [stern] Take this box to the pier. Don't open it. Don't be late.
lines.caption: Take this box to the pier Don't open it Don't be late

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [cheerful] Easy money. What could go wrong?
lines.caption: Easy money What could go wrong?

lines.speaker: slick
lines.tts: [smug] Nice box. I'll take it from here.
lines.caption: Nice box I'll take it from here

lines.speaker: cop
lines.tts: [shouting] Hey! That was a red light!
lines.caption: Hey! That was a red light!

lines.speaker: dj
lines.tts: [amused] Traffic update. Some guy on a scooter is having a very bad day.
lines.caption: Traffic update Some guy on a scooter is having a very bad day

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [panicked] The bridge is going up! No no no no no!
lines.caption: The bridge is going up! No no no no no!

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [out of breath] The whole city chased me! What is in this box?
lines.caption: The whole city chased me! What is in this box?

lines.speaker: cop
lines.tts: [shouting] Freeze! [surprised] Wait. Is that my cake?
lines.caption: Freeze! Wait Is that my cake?

lines.speaker: cop
lines.tts: [happy] Best birthday ever! [stern] You still get a ticket.
lines.caption: Best birthday ever! You still get a ticket

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [outraged] Nine dollars? The ticket was ten!
lines.caption: Nine dollars? The ticket was ten!

lines.speaker: dash
lines.tts: [tired] And that was only day one.
lines.caption: And that was only day one
